information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits one complete executable policy capsule. The second consumes that capsule and reopens only anchor_policy and anchor_contract. The third consumes the resulting complete executable state and reopens only task_constraints and loop_structure. The final call consumes the resulting complete executable closure, reopens only task and candidate_hypothesis, and emits one policy. Downstream evidence windows never overlap.
name: Disjoint Reentry Executable Relay
organization: four-call sequential lineage maintaining one complete executable artifact under mutually exclusive downstream evidence windows

calls.objective: Reconcile the visible evidence and obligations into one complete executable policy artifact without issuing a separate adjudicative boundary.

Consume originate_executable_capsule, assess the inherited complete artifact against only the reentered anchor evidence and contract obligations, reconcile visible conflicts directly in that artifact, and emit one complete executable policy state.

Consume anchor_window_transition, assess the inherited complete artifact against only the reentered constraints and structural evidence, reconcile visible conflicts directly in that artifact, and emit one complete executable policy closure.

Consume constraint_window_transition, assess the inherited complete artifact against only the reentered task and hypothesis evidence, reconcile remaining visible conflicts in that same artifact, and emit one complete policy.
